paragraphs: Student Transportation of America is a contracted student transportation company operating across North America. The company states that it employs 23,500 employees and operates more than 22,000 vehicles across North America. Pages describing the company say it transports 1.25 million students each day.

Founded in 1997, the company describes school districts as the customers it works for. STA describes growth through acquisitions and conversions of locally owned or publicly operated fleets into its own systems. In 2018 the company moved from listings on the NASDAQ and the Toronto Stock Exchange to private ownership with CDPQ. Company history records contracting with Meridian Public Schools in Idaho as the largest district conversion.
